name: Funny Nurse Sticker Pack (100 Pieces)
seoTitle: Funny Nurse Stickers Gift Pack (100 Pcs)
metaDescription: A pack of 100 funny nurse stickers for decorating water bottles, laptops, and clipboards. A budget friendly laugh for nurses, students, and the whole unit.
summary: A hundred funny nurse stickers to cover a water bottle, a laptop, or a study binder with inside jokes from the job.
bestFor: Secret Santa at the nurses station
whyItWorks: Nurses have a sense of humor that only makes sense after a few years on the floor, and stickers are a fun way to show it off. A pack this size means there is plenty to go around. Water bottles get carried through every 12 hour shift, clipboards and binders follow nurses from room to room, and nursing students tend to decorate their laptops with whatever reminds them why they are pushing through school.

Because it is a big pack, it also works well as a shared gift. Drop it in the break room for the team to raid, split it among a few new grads, or tuck a handful into cards for Nurses Week. It is a small, budget friendly gift, so it is ideal when you want to give something lighthearted without going overboard. For a nurse who already has every mug and tote out there, stickers are a fresh option that still feels personal, since they get to pick which ones go where.
goodToKnow: Check the listing to see whether the stickers are waterproof if they will go on a water bottle that gets washed.
Humor varies, so glance at the sticker designs on the listing to be sure they suit the recipient.
Pair the pack with a plain water bottle or a notebook so they have something to decorate right away.

faq.q: Are these stickers appropriate for work?
faq.a: Check the design photos on the listing, since some nurse humor is a little edgy. Most people use these on personal items like bottles and laptops rather than anything patient facing.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for nursing school classmates?
faq.a: Yes. A pack this size is easy to share among a study group or clinical cohort.
